title: 第814章 再出变故第813章 升舱
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
嘭……嘭…………当当当……噗呲噗呲噗呲……
正在闭目修炼的孙云，突然被一阵晃动惊醒。
而且，外面响起了混乱的打斗声，听起来颇为激烈。这突如其来的变故，让孙云摸不着头脑，这又是发生了什么事？
“打劫，把身上的空间装备都拿出来，并且消掉印记！”一个光头大汉，带着一些人冲了进来。
显然，孙云这次出门不利，竟然遇到了海盗。海盗一般都在深海抢劫，到浅海抢劫的很少，毕竟浅海离大陆比较近，容易遭受官方的围杀。
“我是……”
噗呲……
一个女子刚刚要说什么，直接被光头大汉一刀解决了。
光头大汉是七阶巅峰高手，而且一看就是善战的近战高手，刀法又快又狠。有时候，修为不代表一切，战斗经验和战斗意识的强弱，对战斗力影响很大。
“我不管你们是谁，我们是海盗，只认财物！”光头大汉舔了舔刀上的血，嚣张地说道。
随即，带着他的一干手下，开始抢空间装备。一时间，大家都配合了不少，纷纷把自己的空间装备交了出去，首先选择了自保。
其实，这些乘客的整体实力，要超过这些海盗的三倍，但并没有人再出头。毕竟，这些乘客大多互相不认识，一时很难团结起来。谁要是先出头，自然会成为海盗的主要攻击对象，很容易把性命丢在这里。
当当当……噗呲噗呲噗呲……
外面的打斗声，渐渐的停止了下来，显然是海盗获胜了。
他们能来抢劫，自然不会没有把握，肯定是早就计划好了。能拿下这艘客船，显然是有不少海盗，而且整体战斗力不错。
“师兄，怎么办？”
孙云对面的女孩，显然有些紧张，问旁边的白衣男子。
空间装备被抢，也就意味着自己的东西全都被抢走了，她自然是不愿意的。毕竟，有很多人喜欢把自己最重要的东西带在身上，关键时刻可以用。
就算没有非常贵重的东西，失去了空间装备，可就直接变成穷光蛋了。在异国他乡，如果手头没点财力，是很难生存下去的。
“静观其变，总会有人忍不住的。”这白衣男子装作老成地回答道。

毕竟，他们坐在偏里面，外面还有不少乘客呢！只要有人忍不住，选择对海盗出手，很容易引起连锁反应，遭受到所有乘客的反抗。
哗啦啦……
“我……”……
可是，海盗们可不傻，稍微有异动的直接就斩杀，让反抗抹杀在摇篮里面。就这样，海盗的抢劫顺利地进行着，仿佛早就演练好的。
不单单是其他人，孙云也没有反抗，把准备好的空间戒指交了上去。至于丽娜的空间戒指，被孙云偷偷放入了生命空间里，二人直接交出了两个普通的空间戒指。
“师兄……”
白衣女子，见海盗收完空间装备向外走去，焦急地看向白衣男子。是的，他俩也没有反抗，乖乖的交出了空间戒指，白衣男子的想法显然落空了。
content_en:
Bang... Bang... Dang, Dang, Dang... Puff, puff, puff...
Sun Yun, who was practicing with his eyes closed, was suddenly awakened by a shaking.
Moreover, there was a chaotic fighting sound outside, which sounded quite fierce. This sudden change left Sun Yun confused. What happened?
"Robbery, take out all the space equipment and remove the marks!" A bald man rushed in with some people.
Obviously, Sun Yun was in trouble this time when he went out and encountered pirates. Pirates generally rob in the deep sea, and very few go to shallow seas. After all, shallow seas are relatively close to the mainland and are prone to official encirclement and killing.
"I am..."
Phew...
A woman was about to say something, but she was killed by a bald man with a knife.
The bald man is a seventh-level peak master, and at first glance he is a good melee master, with fast and ruthless sword skills. Sometimes, cultivation level does not mean everything. Combat experience and the strength of combat awareness have a great impact on combat effectiveness.
"I don't care who you are, we are pirates, we only care about property!" The bald man licked the blood on the knife and said arrogantly.
Immediately, he led his men and began to grab space equipment. For a time, everyone cooperated a lot and handed over their space equipment one after another, choosing to protect themselves first.
In fact, the overall strength of these passengers was three times greater than that of these pirates, but no one came forward. After all, most of these passengers don’t know each other, so it’s difficult to unite for a while. Whoever takes the lead will naturally become the main target of the pirates' attacks and can easily lose their lives here.
Dang dang dang... Puff, puff, puff...
The fighting outside gradually stopped, and it was obvious that the pirates had won.
Naturally, they would not be unsure if they could come to rob. They must have planned it in advance. To be able to capture this passenger ship, it is obvious that there are many pirates, and the overall combat effectiveness is good.
"Brother, what should I do?"
The girl opposite Sun Yun was obviously a little nervous and asked the man in white next to her.
The space equipment was robbed, which meant that all her belongings were taken away. Naturally, she was unwilling to do so. After all, many people like to carry their most important things with them so that they can be used at critical moments.
Even if you don't have anything very valuable, if you lose your space equipment, you will become a pauper. In a foreign country, it is difficult to survive without any financial resources.
"Just wait and see what happens, there will always be people who can't help it." The man in white replied pretending to be mature.
After all, they were sitting inside, and there were many passengers outside! As long as someone can't help but choose to take action against the pirates, it will easily cause a chain reaction and suffer resistance from all passengers.
Wow…
"I..."...
However, the pirates are not stupid. If there is any slight movement, they will kill them directly and let the resistance be wiped out in the cradle. In this way, the pirate's robbery went smoothly, as if it had been rehearsed long ago.
Not only others, but also Sun Yun did not resist and handed over the prepared space ring. As for Lina's space ring, Sun Yun secretly put it into the life space, and the two of them directly handed over two ordinary space rings.
"Senior brother..."
The woman in white looked anxiously at the man in white when she saw that the pirate had collected the space equipment and walked out. Yes, they didn't resist and handed over the space ring obediently. The man in white obviously lost his mind.
